title: ReviewGuard: Enhancing Deficient Peer Review Detection via LLM-Driven Data Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment analysis using the twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest model to classify the emotional tone of peer reviews and quantify negativity differences between sufficient and deficient reviews.
Categorization of peer review texts into an 'Others' deficiency subtype using GPT-4.1 annotation and human validation to capture deviations like prestige bias.
